en.s: The Battle of Hormozdgan (also spelled Hormizdagan and Hormozgan) was the climactic battle between the Arsacid and the Sasanian dynasties that took place on 28 April 224. The Sasanian victory broke the power of the Parthian dynasty, effectively ending almost five centuries of Parthian rule in Iran, and marking the official start of the Sasanian era.

zh.s: 霍尔木兹甘战役也拼作霍尔米兹达甘战役或霍尔木兹甘战役，是阿萨息斯王朝与萨珊王朝之间的决定性战役，于224年4月28日发生。萨珊王朝获胜，打破了帕提亚王朝的势力，实际上结束了其近五个世纪的统治，并标志着萨珊时代正式开始。

en.t: Assassination of Conrad of Montferrat (Conrad I), King of Jerusalem, in Tyre, two days after his title to the throne is confirmed by election. The killing is carried out by Hashshashin
en.s: Conrad of Montferrat (c. 1146 – 28 April 1192) was an Italian nobleman, one of the major participants in the Third Crusade. He was the de facto King of Jerusalem (as Conrad I) by virtue of his marriage to Isabella I of Jerusalem from 24 November 1190, but officially elected only in 1192, days before his death. He was also the eighth Marquess of Montferrat from 1191.

zh.t: 耶路撒冷国王康拉德一世在提尔遇刺
zh.s: 康拉德·蒙费拉托（约1146年—1192年4月28日）是意大利贵族，也是第三次十字军东征的主要参与者之一。他与耶路撒冷的伊莎贝拉一世结婚后，自1190年11月24日起成为事实上的耶路撒冷国王（康拉德一世），但直到1192年才正式当选，并在当选数日后遇害。他从1191年起也是第八任蒙费拉托侯爵。

en.s: The Sicilian Vespers (Italian: Vespri siciliani; Sicilian: Vespiri siciliani) was a successful rebellion on the island of Sicily that broke out at Easter 1282 against the rule of the French-born king Charles I of Anjou. Since taking control of the Kingdom of Sicily in 1266, the Angevin government had made itself unpopular with its exploitative policies and exclusion of native Sicilians from power.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 西西里晚祷起义（意大利语：Vespri siciliani；西西里语：Vespiri siciliani）是1282年复活节期间发生在西西里岛的一场成功起义，反抗法国出身的国王安茹的查理一世。自1266年控制西西里王国以来，安茹王朝政府实行剥削政策，并排斥西西里本地人参与掌权，因此逐渐失去民心。

en.t: Temür, grandson of Kublai, is elected Khagan of the Mongols with the reigning title Oljeitu
en.s: Kublai Khan (23 September 1215 – 18 February 1294), also known by his temple name as the Emperor Shizu of Yuan and his regnal name Setsen Khan, was the founder and first emperor of the Mongol-led Yuan dynasty of China. He proclaimed the dynastic name "Great Yuan" in 1271, and ruled Yuan China until his death in 1294.

zh.t: 忽必烈之孙铁穆耳当选蒙古大汗，尊号完泽笃汗
zh.s: 忽必烈（1215年9月23日—1294年2月18日）是中国蒙古人建立的元朝的开国皇帝。他也以庙号元世祖和尊号薛禅汗为人所知。1271年，他宣布国号为“大元”，此后统治元朝中国，直至1294年去世。

en.s: The conquest of Malatya was led by Tankiz, the viceroy of Syria, under the orders of Sultan al-Nasir Muhammad, resulting in the annexation of Malatya to the Mamluk Sultanate.

zh.s: 叙利亚总督坦基兹奉苏丹纳赛尔·穆罕默德之命率军征服马拉蒂亚，并将其并入马穆鲁克苏丹国。

en.s: The Battle of Trnava or Battle of Nagyszombat took place during the Hussite Wars between the Hussites and the Hungarian-Royalists-Serbian army near Trnava (Nagyszombat) in the Kingdom of Hungary (today in Slovakia). The battle was fought in three phases, on 23, 25 and 28 April 1430 and ended in Hussite victory. In the summer of 1430, 10,000 Hussites from Moravia invaded Hungary under Velek Koudelník of Březnice.

zh.s: 特尔纳瓦战役又称瑙吉松鲍特战役，是胡斯战争期间胡斯派与匈牙利—王室—塞尔维亚联军在特尔纳瓦附近发生的战斗。当时该地属于匈牙利王国，如今位于斯洛伐克。战役分三个阶段，分别于1430年4月23日、25日和28日进行，最终胡斯派获胜。1430年夏，来自摩拉维亚的1万名胡斯派士兵在布热兹尼采的维莱克·库德尔尼克率领下入侵匈牙利。

en.s: The Battle of Crevola was fought in the spring of 1487, between a marauding Swiss army from the Valais and Lucerne and troops from the Duchy of Milan, for the supremacy of the Val d'Ossola (Eschental) .

zh.s: 1487年春，来自瓦莱州和卢塞恩的瑞士军队四处劫掠，与米兰公国的军队交战，争夺奥索拉山谷（埃申塔尔）的控制权。

en.s: The Battle of Cerignola was fought on April 28, 1503, between Spanish and French armies, in Cerignola, near Bari in Southern Italy. Spanish forces, under Gonzalo Fernández de Córdoba, formed by 6,300 men, including 2,000 landsknechte, with more than 1,000 arquebusiers, and 20 cannons, defeated the French who had 9,000 men; mainly heavy gendarme cavalry and Swiss mercenary pikemen, with about 40 cannons, and led by Louis d'Armagnac, Duke of Nemours, who was killed.

zh.s: 切里尼奥拉战役于1503年4月28日在意大利南部巴里附近的切里尼奥拉发生，交战双方是西班牙和法国军队。贡萨洛·费尔南德斯·德·科尔多瓦率领6300名西班牙士兵，其中包括2000名兰茨克内希特雇佣兵、1000多名火绳枪手和20门火炮，击败了由讷穆尔公爵路易·达尔马尼亚率领的9000名法军。法军主要由重装骑兵和瑞士长矛兵组成，配有约40门火炮；路易在战斗中阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Wisniowiec (also known as the Battle of Lopuszno) took place on 28 April 1512. The combined Polish–Lithuanian forces under Grand Crown Hetman Mikołaj Kamieniecki and Grand Lithuanian Hetman Konstanty Ostrogski defeated the raid of the Crimean Tatars. The battle was fought in Lopushne near Wisniowiec.

zh.s: 维什尼奥韦茨战役又称沃普什诺战役，发生于1512年4月28日。波兰立陶宛联军在大王冠赫特曼米科瓦伊·卡缅涅茨基和立陶宛大赫特曼康斯坦丁·奥斯特罗格斯基率领下，击退了克里米亚鞑靼人的袭击。战斗发生在维什尼奥韦茨附近的沃普什内。

en.s: The Battle of Capo d'Orso, sometimes known as the Battle of Cava and the Battle of Amalfi, was a naval engagement taking place from 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM on April 28, 1528, during the War of the League of Cognac. A French fleet inflicted a crushing defeat on the fleet of the Kingdom of Naples under Spanish command in the Gulf of Salerno, where Spanish forces trying to break the French blockade of the city met the French fleet.

zh.s: 奥尔索角海战又称卡瓦海战或阿马尔菲海战，于1528年4月28日下午5时至9时发生，是康布雷同盟战争的一部分。西班牙指挥的那不勒斯王国舰队试图突破法国对萨莱诺城的封锁，在萨莱诺湾遭遇法国舰队并被其重创。

en.t: Establishment of the Pontifical and Royal University of Santo Tomas, the Catholic University of the Philippines and the largest Catholic university in the world
en.s: The University of Santo Tomas (UST; Filipino: Unibersidad ng Santo Tomás), officially the Pontifical and Royal University of Santo Tomas, The Catholic University of the Philippines or colloquially as Ustê (pronounced [usˈtɛʔ]), is a private Catholic research university in Manila, Philippines. Founded on April 28, 1611, by Spanish friar Miguel de Benavides, third Archbishop of Manila, it has the oldest extant university charter in Asia and is one of the world's largest Catholic universities in terms of enrollment found on one campus.

zh.s: 圣多玛斯大学（UST；菲律宾语：Unibersidad ng Santo Tomás）是一所位于菲律宾马尼拉的私立天主教研究型大学，正式名称为宗座暨皇家圣多玛斯大学、菲律宾天主教大学，俗称Ustê（发音：[usˈtɛʔ]）。1611年4月28日，马尼拉第三任总主教、西班牙修士米格尔·德·贝纳维德斯创办了该校。它拥有亚洲现存最古老的大学特许状，也是全球单一校园学生人数最多的天主教大学之一。

en.s: The Invasion of Gotland (Danish: Erobringen af Gotland/Gulland; Swedish: Erövringen av Gotland) was a Danish sea-borne invasion of the Swedish island of Gotland in the Baltic Sea, led by admiral Niels Juel during the Scanian War. The invasion took place from 28 April to 1 May 1676. Gotland was occupied by Denmark until 1679, when the war was formally ended.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 丹麦入侵哥特兰岛（丹麦语：Erobringen af Gotland/Gulland；瑞典语：Erövringen av Gotland）是斯堪尼亚战争期间，尼尔斯·尤埃尔海军上将率领丹麦军队从海上入侵波罗的海瑞典岛屿哥特兰的行动。入侵于1676年4月28日至5月1日进行。战争于1679年正式结束前，丹麦一直占领哥特兰岛。

en.s: The Battle of Chelif or Battle of Djidouia took place on 28 April 1701 on the banks of the Chelif River. It was fought between the armies of the Alaouite Sultan Ismail Ibn Sharif and those of the Regency of Algiers commanded by the Bey of Mascara, Mustapha Bouchelaghem.

zh.s: 谢利夫河战役又称吉杜亚战役，于1701年4月28日在谢利夫河畔发生。交战双方是阿拉维王朝苏丹伊斯梅尔·本·谢里夫的军队，以及由马斯卡拉贝伊穆斯塔法·布切拉格姆率领的阿尔及尔摄政政府军队。

en.s: The Battle of Dabhoi was fought on 28 April 1731, and it was a major confrontation between the Trimbak Rao Dabhade and Baji Rao I due to political interference of Peshwas in Gujarat Province. It was fought due to rights of Chauth (Tax Collection) of Gujarat. The rights of collecting Chauth of Gujarat was held by Dabhade clan from the time of Khanderao Dabhade.

zh.s: 达博伊战役于1731年4月28日爆发，是特里姆巴克·拉奥·达巴德与巴吉·拉奥一世之间的一场重大冲突，起因是佩什瓦家族干预古吉拉特省事务。双方围绕古吉拉特地区的“乔特税”（一种税收征收权）发生冲突。自坎德拉奥·达巴德时期起，达巴德家族一直拥有征收该税的权利。

en.t: Pope Clement XII issues the first papal condemnation of Freemasonry and formally prohibits Catholics from becoming Freemasons
en.s: Pope Clement XII (Latin: Clemens XII; Italian: Clemente XII; 7 April 1652 – 6 February 1740), born Lorenzo Corsini, was head of the Catholic Church and leader of the Papal States from 12 July 1730 to his death in February 1740. Clement presided over the growth of a surplus in the papal finances.

zh.t: 教宗克勉十二世首次谴责共济会，并正式禁止天主教徒加入
zh.s: 教宗克勉十二世（拉丁文：Clemens XII；意大利文：Clemente XII），本名洛伦佐·科西尼，生于1652年4月7日，卒于1740年2月6日。他自1730年7月12日起担任天主教会领袖和教宗国统治者，直至1740年2月去世。在他任内，教宗国财政逐渐出现盈余。

en.s: The Battle of Sainte-Foy, sometimes called the Battle of Quebec, was fought on April 28, 1760 near the British-held town of Quebec in the French province of Canada during the Seven Years' War (called the French and Indian War in the United States). It was a victory for the French under the Chevalier de Lévis over the British army under General Murray. The battle was notably bloodier than the Battle of the Plains of Abraham of the previous September, with 833 French casualties to 1,124 British casualties. It was the last French victory of the French and Indian War.

zh.s: 圣福瓦战役有时也称魁北克战役，于1760年4月28日在英军控制的魁北克镇附近爆发。当时魁北克位于法国的加拿大省，这场战役属于七年战争的一部分（在美国称为法印战争）。舍瓦利埃·德·莱维率领的法军击败了默里将军指挥的英军。此役的伤亡比前一年9月的亚伯拉罕平原战役更惨重：法军伤亡833人，英军伤亡1,124人。这是法印战争中法国最后一次获胜。

en.s: The siege of Bednore was a battle of the Second Anglo-Mysore War. The British had captured Bednore (modern day Nagara) and other strongholds in the Malabar coast from Mysore in early 1783, while the Mysore leader, Tipu Sultan, was leading his army on campaign in the Carnatic. The British commander, Brigadier-General Richard Matthews, formed a small garrison of 1,600 men at Bednore and split the remainder of the force into detachments to plunder the surrounding region.

zh.s: 贝德努尔围城战是第二次英迈索尔战争中的一场战役。1783年初，英军从迈索尔王国手中夺取了贝德努尔（今纳加拉）以及马拉巴尔海岸的其他据点。当时迈索尔统治者蒂普苏丹正率军在卡纳提克地区作战。英军指挥官理查德·马修斯准将留下一支1,600人的小型驻军守卫贝德努尔，并将其余部队拆分成多个分遣队，去周边地区掠夺。

en.s: The Mutiny on the Bounty occurred in the Pacific Ocean on 28 April 1789. Disaffected crewmen, led by acting-Lieutenant Fletcher Christian, seized control of the Royal Navy merchant ship HMS Bounty from its captain, Lieutenant William Bligh, and set him and 18 loyalists adrift in the ship's open launch. The reasons behind the mutiny are still debated.

zh.s: 邦蒂号哗变于1789年4月28日在太平洋发生。一群心怀不满的船员在代理中尉弗莱彻·克里斯蒂安带领下，夺取了英国皇家海军商船邦蒂号的控制权。船长威廉·布莱和18名忠于他的船员被放上一艘敞篷小艇，任其漂流。哗变的原因至今仍有争议。

en.s: The capture of Porrentruy was a siege of the Swiss town of Porrentruy. The town was held by Austria and attacked by the French. The event occurred on 28 April 1792 and resulted in victory for the French forces. This engagement marked the commencement of the War of the First Coalition.

zh.s: 法军攻占波朗特吕是一次针对瑞士城镇波朗特吕的围城战。当时该镇由奥地利控制，遭到法国军队进攻。战斗发生于1792年4月28日，最终法军获胜，也标志着第一次反法同盟战争开始。

en.s: The Second Battle of Saorgio was fought from 24 to 28 April 1794 between a French First Republic army commanded by Pierre Jadart Dumerbion and the armies of the Kingdom of Sardinia-Piedmont and the Habsburg monarchy led by Joseph Nikolaus De Vins. It was part of a successful French offensive designed to capture strategic positions in the Maritime Alps and Ligurian Alps, and on the Mediterranean coast.

zh.s: 萨奥尔焦第二次战役于1794年4月24日至28日进行，交战双方是皮埃尔·雅达尔·迪梅尔比翁率领的法兰西第一共和国军队，以及约瑟夫·尼古拉斯·德·万斯率领的撒丁-皮埃蒙特王国和哈布斯堡君主国联军。该战役是法国一次成功攻势的一部分，旨在夺取海上阿尔卑斯山、利古里亚阿尔卑斯山及地中海沿岸的战略要地。

en.s: The Montenotte campaign began on 10 April 1796 with an action at Voltri and ended with the Armistice of Cherasco on 28 April. It was the beginning of the Italian Campaign of 1796–1797, which would ultimately end the War of the First Coalition a year later. In his first army command, Napoleon Bonaparte's French army separated the army of the Kingdom of Sardinia-Piedmont under Michelangelo Alessandro Colli-Marchi from the allied Habsburg army led by Johann Peter Beaulieu.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 蒙特诺特战役于1796年4月10日开始，始于沃尔特里的交战，并于4月28日以谢拉斯科停战协定结束。这是1796至1797年意大利战役的开端，该战役最终使第一次反法同盟战争于一年后结束。在首次担任军队统帅期间，拿破仑·波拿巴率领法军击退了米开朗基罗·亚历山德罗·科利-马尔基率领的撒丁-皮埃蒙特王国军队，并将其与约翰·彼得·博略率领的哈布斯堡盟军分开。

en.s: The Battle of Čokešina (Serbian: Битка код Чокешине), also referred to as the "Serbian Thermopylae", was fought on Lazarus Saturday, 28 April 1804, by an outnumbered Serbian insurgent army made up of 300 hajduks under the command of the Nedić brothers against the Dahije (renegade Janissaries) who were supported by Ottoman Bosnian troops. It took place near the Monastery of Čokešina, not far from Loznica.

zh.s: 乔凯希纳战役（塞尔维亚语：Битка код Чокешине）又称“塞尔维亚的温泉关战役”，于1804年4月28日的拉撒路星期六爆发。由内迪奇兄弟指挥的300名塞尔维亚叛军海杜克，寡不敌众地迎战由叛变近卫军支持的奥斯曼波斯尼亚军队。战斗发生在乔凯希纳修道院附近，距洛兹尼察不远。

en.s: The Battle of Furuholm was a naval battle that took place at Furuholm outside Strömstad on April 28, 1808 as part of the Dano-Swedish War of 1808-1809.

zh.s: 富鲁霍尔姆海战于1808年4月28日在斯特伦斯塔德附近的富鲁霍尔姆海域发生，是1808至1809年丹麦—瑞典战争的一部分。

en.s: The British expedition to Palembang took place in April 1812, led by Colonel Robert Rollo Gillespie against Sultan Mahmud Badaruddin II. The expedition aimed to force the sultanate to cede the island of Bangka to the colonial government, while citing a massacre of the Dutch garrison in Palembang in 1811 as justification. Upon the approach of the expedition forces, Palembang's defenses with their guns were captured by British forces without fighting.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1812年4月，罗伯特·罗洛·吉莱斯皮上校率英国军队远征巨港，对抗苏丹马哈茂德·巴达鲁丁二世。此次远征旨在迫使苏丹国将邦加岛割让给殖民政府；英方以1811年荷兰驻军在巨港遭屠杀为由发动行动。远征军接近后，英军不战而缴获了巨港的防御工事和火炮。

en.s: The siege of Fort Meigs was a significant War of 1812 military engagement in northwestern Ohio during the spring of 1813. British regulars and militia led by Brigadier General Henry Procter, supported by Indigenous forces led by Tecumseh, attempted to capture the recently constructed fort in order to forestall Major General William Henry Harrison's campaign to retake Detroit and invade Upper Canada.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 梅格斯堡围城战是1812年战争期间，1813年春季在俄亥俄州西北部发生的一场重要军事行动。由准将亨利·普罗克特率领的英国正规军和民兵，在特库姆塞率领的原住民部队支援下，试图攻占新建成的梅格斯堡，以阻止威廉·亨利·哈里森少将收复底特律并入侵上加拿大。

en.s: The Battle of Pesaro was a minor battle in the Neapolitan War that took place on 28 April 1815 in the town of Pesaro. The main Neapolitan army, commanded by their king, Joachim Murat, was retreating to their original headquarters in Ancona following a string a defeats in northern Italy. The Neapolitans were being pursued by an Austrian corps under the command of Adam Albert von Neipperg. Just like at the Battle of Cesenatico, a vastly outnumbered Austrian raiding party of hussars and jägers once again successfully attacked a Neapolitan garrison of 3,000 men during the night.

zh.s: 佩萨罗战役是那不勒斯战争中的一场小规模战斗，1815年4月28日发生在佩萨罗镇。那不勒斯主力军在国王约阿希姆·缪拉的率领下，因在意大利北部连连失利，正撤回安科纳的原总部。追击他们的是亚当·阿尔贝特·冯·奈佩格率领的奥地利军团。与切塞纳蒂科战役类似，一支人数远少于对手的奥地利轻骑兵和猎兵小队再次在夜间突袭了一支由3000人守卫的那不勒斯驻军。

en.s: The Bawani Imli massacre (Hindi: बावनी इमली हत्याकांड) was the execution of 52 Indian freedom fighters including Thakur Jodha Singh Ataiya by British East India Company forces on 28 April 1858 during the Indian Rebellion of 1857. The executions took place on a tamarind tree, locally known as "Bawani Imli" (meaning "52 tamarind"), 6 km from Bindki tehsil, and located 30 km from the town of Khajuha in Fatehpur district, Uttar Pradesh, India.

en.s: The battle of the San Lorenzo River was the first engagement between Paraguayan and Argentine forces in the Paraguayan War. The combat took place near the San Lorenzo River, in Argentina, on April 28, 1865 during the Corrientes Campaign and ended with the victory of the Paraguayans.

zh.s: 圣洛伦索河战役是巴拉圭战争期间巴拉圭与阿根廷军队之间的首次交战。战斗于1865年4月28日在阿根廷圣洛伦索河附近发生，是科连特斯战役的一部分，最终巴拉圭军队获胜。

zh.s: 纪尧姆·施纳贝莱（也作威廉·施内贝勒，1831年—1900年12月5日）是来自阿尔萨斯的法国官员。他因1887年4月的施纳贝莱事件中被德国人逮捕而闻名；这起事件几乎导致法国与德国开战。

en.s: The 1901 Coupe Vanden Abeele (English: Vanden Abeele Cup) was a friendly football match held at the ground of Beerschot A.C. in Antwerp, on 28 April 1901. That match was contested by representative teams of Belgium and the Netherlands, and ended in a 8–0 win to the Belgians, but more important than the result was its historical significance, as it was the first international football match played in continental Europe, official or otherwise.

en.s: The 1906 Scottish Cup Final was played on 28 April 1906 at Ibrox Park in Govan (today part of Glasgow) and was the final of the 33rd season of the Scottish Cup. Heart of Midlothian and Third Lanark contested the match, won 1–0 by Hearts thanks to an 81st-minute goal from George Wilson.

zh.s: 1906年苏格兰杯决赛于1906年4月28日在戈文的伊布罗克斯公园举行（该地现属格拉斯哥），决出第33届苏格兰杯冠军。哈茨与第三拉纳克对阵，最终哈茨凭借乔治·威尔逊第81分钟的进球以1比0获胜。

en.s: The 1906 Sheriff of London Charity Shield was the ninth Sheriff of London Charity Shield, contested for the first time by Liverpool F.C. and the 8th time by Corinthian. The match was eagerly anticipated due to Corinthian having only lost a single match in the season and Liverpool being widely regarded as among the best teams in the country.

en.s: The 1909 FA Charity Shield was the second Charity Shield, a football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Football League and Southern League competitions. The match was played on 28 April 1909, between 1908–09 Football League winners Newcastle United and 1908–09 Southern League champions Northampton Town. The match was played at Stamford Bridge, London, and ended with a 2–0 win for Newcastle United.

zh.s: 1909年英格兰足总慈善盾是第二届慈善盾足球赛，由上赛季英格兰足球联赛冠军对阵南方足球联赛冠军。比赛于1909年4月28日举行，对阵双方是1908至1909赛季英格兰足球联赛冠军纽卡斯尔联和南方足球联赛冠军北安普顿。比赛在伦敦斯坦福桥球场进行，纽卡斯尔联以2比0获胜。

en.s: The 1910 London to Manchester air race took place between two aviators, each of whom attempted to win a heavier-than-air powered flight challenge between London and Manchester. The race had first been proposed by the Daily Mail newspaper in 1906. The £10,000 prize was won in April 1910 by Frenchman Louis Paulhan. The first to make the attempt was Claude Grahame-White, an Englishman from Hampshire.
en.n: Frenchman Louis Paulhan wins the 1910 London to Manchester air race, the first long-distance aeroplane race in the United Kingdom.

zh.s: 1910年伦敦至曼彻斯特航空竞赛由两名飞行员参加，两人都试图完成伦敦至曼彻斯特的重于空气动力飞行挑战。竞赛最初由《每日邮报》于1906年提出。1万英镑奖金于1910年4月颁给法国飞行员路易·保罗汉。首位尝试者是来自汉普郡的英国人克劳德·格雷厄姆-怀特。

en.s: The First Battle of Krithia (Turkish: Birinci Kirte Muharebesi) was the first Allied attempt to advance in the Battle of Gallipoli during the First World War. Starting on 28 April, three days after the Landing at Cape Helles, the defensive power of the Ottoman forces quickly overwhelmed the attack, which suffered from poor leadership and planning, lack of communications, and exhausted and demoralised troops.

zh.s: 克里西娅第一次战役（又称土耳其语：Birinci Kirte Muharebesi）是第一次世界大战期间，协约国在加里波利战役中首次尝试推进。战役于4月28日开始，即赫勒斯角登陆三天后。奥斯曼军队的防御很快击退了进攻；协约国部队指挥和计划不周、通信不足，士兵也已疲惫且士气低落。

en.s: The Battle of Ashbourne took place, near Ashbourne, County Meath, during the Easter Rising in Ireland in 1916. The Rising, also known as the Easter Rebellion, was an armed insurrection in Ireland during Easter Week in April 1916. The Rising was launched by Irish republicans against British rule in Ireland with the aim of establishing an independent Irish Republic. It was the first armed conflict of the Irish revolutionary period.

zh.s: 1916年爱尔兰复活节起义期间，阿什伯恩战役在米斯郡阿什伯恩附近爆发。复活节起义也称复活节叛乱，是爱尔兰共和派于1916年4月复活节周发起的武装起义，反抗英国统治，目标是建立独立的爱尔兰共和国。这是爱尔兰革命时期的第一场武装冲突。

en.s: General elections were held in Portugal on 28 April 1918, following a coup by Sidónio Pais in December 1917. The elections were boycotted by the Democratic Party, the Evolutionist Party and the Republican Union, who had won over 90% of the seats in the 1915 elections. Although they included the first direct vote election for the position of President, Pais was the only candidate and the vote was uncontested. In the parliamentary elections the result was a victory for the National Republican Party, which won 108 of the 155 seats in the House of Representatives and 32 of the 73 seats in the indirectly elected Senate.

zh.s: 1918年4月28日，葡萄牙举行大选。此次选举是在西多尼奥·派斯于1917年12月发动政变后举行的。民主党、进化党和共和联盟抵制选举；这三个政党在1915年选举中赢得了超过九成席位。选举首次采用总统直选，但派斯是唯一候选人，因此没有竞争。议会选举中，全国共和党获胜，在众议院155席中赢得108席，并在间接选举产生的参议院73席中赢得32席。

zh.s: 阿塞拜疆苏维埃社会主义共和国简称阿塞拜疆苏维埃社会主义共和国（ASSR），也称阿塞拜疆苏维埃共和国、阿塞拜疆苏维埃社会主义共和国、阿塞拜疆苏维埃共和国、苏维埃阿塞拜疆或阿塞拜疆。它是苏联的加盟共和国之一，存在于1922年至1991年。阿塞拜疆苏维埃社会主义共和国于1920年4月28日红军入侵阿塞拜疆后成立。

en.s: Li Dazhao (simplified Chinese: 李大钊; traditional Chinese: 李大釗; pinyin: Lǐ Dàzhāo; Wade–Giles: Li Ta-chao; 29 October 1889 – 28 April 1927) was a Chinese intellectual, revolutionary, and political activist who co-founded the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) with Chen Duxiu in 1921. en.s: The Independence Producers were a minor league baseball team based in Independence, Kansas, United States that played from 1921 to 1925 and from 1928 to 1932. From 1921 to 1924, they played in the Southwestern League, and in 1925 they played in the Western Association. They played in the Western Association from 1928 to 1932 as well. Perhaps their most notable alumnus was Cy Blanton. Glenn Wright, another notable Producer, made an unassisted triple play when playing Major League Baseball in 1925. According to an historical marker, the first night game in organized baseball was played in Independence on April 28, 1930, between the Independence Producers and the Muskogee Chiefs.

zh.s: 独立城生产者队是一支位于美国堪萨斯州独立城的小联盟棒球队，曾于1921至1925年和1928至1932年参赛。1921至1924年，球队参加西南联盟；1925年参加西部协会。1928至1932年，球队也参加西部协会。球队较有名的校友包括Cy Blanton。另一位知名球员Glenn Wright在1925年打出过一次无助攻三杀。根据一块历史标牌，有组织棒球赛的首场夜间比赛于1930年4月28日在独立城举行，对阵双方是生产者队和马斯科吉酋长队。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Venezuela on 28 April 1941 to elect the successor of President of Venezuela Eleazar López Contreras. This presidential election, unlike the elections held since 1947, was indirect, that is, the voters were the deputies and senators of the Congress of Venezuela. The winner on this day was Isaías Medina Angarita with 120 votes, 87.6% of the seats in the Congress.

zh.s: 委内瑞拉于1941年4月28日举行总统选举，选出埃莱亚萨尔·洛佩斯·孔特雷拉斯的继任者。这次选举与1947年之后的选举不同，采用间接选举方式，由委内瑞拉国会的议员和参议员投票。伊萨亚斯·梅迪纳·安加里塔以120票获胜，相当于国会席位的87.6%。

en.s: The Gudovac massacre was the mass killing of around 190 Bjelovar Serbs by the Croatian nationalist Ustaše movement on 28 April 1941, during World War II. The massacre occurred shortly after the German-led Axis invasion of Yugoslavia and the establishment of the Ustaše-led Axis puppet state known as the Independent State of Croatia (NDH).

zh.s: 1941年4月28日，第二次世界大战期间，克罗地亚民族主义组织乌斯塔沙在古多瓦茨大规模杀害了约190名别洛瓦尔塞族人。屠杀发生在德国主导的轴心国入侵南斯拉夫、乌斯塔沙领导的轴心国傀儡政权克罗地亚独立国成立后不久。

en.s: Exercise Tiger, or Operation Tiger, was one of the rehearsals for the D-Day invasion of Normandy. Held in April 1944 on Slapton Sands in Devon, it proved fraught with difficulties. Coordination and communication problems resulted in friendly fire injuries during the exercise, and an Allied convoy preparing for the landing was attacked by E-boats of Nazi Germany's Kriegsmarine, resulting in the deaths of at least 749 American servicemen.

zh.s: 老虎演习又称老虎行动，是诺曼底登陆前的一次演习。演习于1944年4月在德文郡斯莱普顿海滩举行，过程问题重重。协调和通信失误导致友军误伤；一支准备参加登陆的盟军船队还遭到纳粹德国海军的鱼雷快艇袭击，至少749名美国军人丧生。

en.s: The Dachau Uprising (German: Dachauer Aufstand) was a revolt of Dachau prisoners, citizens of Dachau and deserters on 28 April 1945, aimed at disempowering party officials willing to fight, as well as Schutzstaffel (SS) and Volkssturm units during the last stages of World War II. It also sought to end Nazi rule in the town, prevent the liquidation of the concentration camp and the murder of the surviving prisoners.

zh.s: 达豪起义（德语：Dachauer Aufstand）于1945年4月28日爆发，参与者包括达豪集中营囚犯、当地居民和逃兵。他们试图解除那些仍想继续战斗的纳粹党官员、党卫军和国民突击队的武装，结束纳粹对该镇的统治，阻止集中营被清空，并防止幸存囚犯遭到杀害。

en.s: Operation Cowboy was fought in the town of Hostau, Sudetenland (now Hostouň in the Czech Republic), on 28 April 1945, in the last days of fighting in the European theater of World War II. It is one of two known incidents during the war in which Americans and Germans of the Wehrmacht fought side by side against the Waffen-SS , the other being the Battle of Castle Itter.

zh.s: 牛仔行动于1945年4月28日在苏台德地区的霍斯陶镇（今捷克霍斯托温）进行，当时第二次世界大战欧洲战场的战斗已接近尾声。这是已知的两起二战期间美军与德国国防军并肩对抗党卫军的事件之一；另一起是伊特尔城堡战役。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Australia on 28 April 1951. All 121 seats in the House of Representatives, and all 60 seats in the Senate were up for election, due to a double dissolution called after the Senate rejected the Commonwealth Bank Bill. The incumbent Liberal Party of Australia led by Prime Minister of Australia Robert Menzies with coalition partner the Country Party led by Arthur Fadden defeated the Australian Labor Party led by Ben Chifley.

zh.s: 1951年4月28日，澳大利亚举行联邦大选。由于参议院否决《联邦银行法案》，政府解散两院提前选举，众议院121席和参议院60席全部改选。由总理罗伯特·孟席斯领导的澳大利亚自由党与亚瑟·法登领导的乡村党组成联盟，击败了本·奇夫利领导的澳大利亚工党。

en.s: The 1951 FA Cup final was contested by Newcastle United and Blackpool at Wembley on 28 April 1951. Newcastle won 2–0, with both goals scored by Jackie Milburn. Bill Slater, who played at inside left for losers Blackpool, was the last surviving player to have appeared in the final. He died in December 2018 at the age of 91.

zh.s: 1951年英格兰足总杯决赛于1951年4月28日在温布利举行，由纽卡斯尔联对阵布莱克浦。纽卡斯尔联以2比0获胜，杰基·米尔本打入两球。布莱克浦的左内锋比尔·斯莱特是这场决赛最后一位在世的球员，他于2018年12月去世，享年91岁。

en.s: The Sino-Japanese Peace Treaty (Chinese: 中日和平條約; Japanese: 日華平和条約), commonly known as the Treaty of Taipei (Chinese: 台北和約), was a peace treaty between Japan and the Republic of China (ROC) signed in Taipei, Taiwan on April 28, 1952 and took effect on August 5 the same year, marking the formal end of the Second Sino-Japanese War (1937–45). This treaty was necessary, because neither the Republic of China nor the People's Republic of China was invited to sign the Treaty of San Francisco due to disagreements by other countries as to which government was the legitimate government of China during and after the Chinese Civil War.

zh.s: 《中日和平条约》（日文：日華平和条約），通常称为《台北和约》，是日本与中华民国于1952年4月28日在台湾台北签署的和平条约，同年8月5日生效，正式结束1937至1945年的第二次中日战争。当时，由于各国对中国内战前后哪一方政府具有合法代表权存在分歧，中华民国和中华人民共和国都没有获邀签署《旧金山和约》，因此需要另行签署这份条约。

en.s: The Treaty of San Francisco, also called the Treaty of Peace with Japan, re-established peaceful relations between Japan and the Allies on behalf of the United Nations by ending the legal state of war, military occupation and providing for redress for hostile actions up to and including World War II. It was signed by 49 nations on September 8, 1951, in San Francisco, United States, at the War Memorial Opera House.

zh.s: 《旧金山和约》也称《对日和平条约》，代表联合国同盟国与日本结束法律上的战争状态和军事占领，恢复和平关系，并规定对包括第二次世界大战期间在内的敌对行为进行赔偿。1951年9月8日，49个国家在美国旧金山战争纪念歌剧院签署了该条约。

en.s: General elections were held in British Honduras on 28 April 1954, the first held under universal suffrage. The new constitution replaced the Legislative Council with a Legislative Assembly, which had nine elected members, three officials and three appointed members. The result was a decisive victory for the pro-independence People's United Party, which won eight of the nine seats in a coalition with the General Workers' Union.

zh.s: 1954年4月28日，英属洪都拉斯举行大选，这是该地首次实行普选。新宪法以立法议会取代立法局，议会由9名民选议员、3名政府官员和3名委任议员组成。支持独立的人民联合党与总工会组成联盟，赢得9席中的8席，取得压倒性胜利。

en.s: The 1959 Sioux Falls mayoral election took place on April 28, 1959, following a primary election on April 21, 1959. Incumbent Mayor Fay Wheeldon ran for re-election. While former Governor Joe Foss was viewed as a potential candidate, he ultimately declined to run. Wheeldon placed second in the primary election, winning 33 percent of the vote to real estate agent Wendell Hanson's 42 percent.

zh.s: 1959年苏福尔斯市长选举于4月28日举行，初选则在同年4月21日举行。时任市长费伊·惠尔登竞选连任。前州长乔·福斯一度被视为可能参选，但最终没有参选。惠尔登在初选中排名第二，获得33%的选票；房地产经纪人温德尔·汉森以42%居首。

en.s: The Port Francqui incident, also known as the Port Francqui massacre, was an incident during the Congo Crisis where rogue Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (ANC) forces engaged in combat with UN peacekeepers, primarily from Ghana. The fighting resulted in the largest loss of life the Ghanaian Armed Forces have suffered while peacekeeping.

zh.s: 弗朗基港事件也称弗朗基港惨案，是刚果危机期间发生的一起事件。当时刚果民主共和国武装部队（ANC）中一支不受控制的部队与联合国维和人员交战，维和人员主要来自加纳。这场战斗造成加纳武装部队在维和行动中遭受的最大人员损失。

en.s: Lombardy elected its third delegation to the Italian Senate on April 28, 1963. This election was a part of national Italian general election of 1963 even if, according to the Italian Constitution, every senatorial challenge in each Region is a single and independent race. The election was won by the centrist Christian Democracy, as it happened at national level. Eight Lombard provinces gave a majority or at least a plurality to the winning party, while the agricultural Province of Pavia preferred the Italian Communist Party.

zh.t: 1963年意大利参议院伦巴第大区选举
zh.s: 1963年4月28日，伦巴第选出第三届意大利参议院代表团。这次选举是1963年意大利大选的一部分，不过根据意大利宪法，各大区的参议员选举都是单独进行的。中间派基督教民主党获胜，与全国结果一致。伦巴第八个省份的选民多数或相对多数支持该党，农业省份帕维亚则支持意大利共产党。

en.s: General elections were held in Italy on April 28, 1963, to select the Fourth Republican Parliament. It was the first election with a fixed number of MPs to be elected, as decided by the second Constitutional Reform in February 1963. It was also the first election which saw the Secretary of Christian Democracy to refuse the office of Prime Minister after the vote, at least for six months, preferring to provisionally maintain his more influent post at the head of the party: this fact confirmed the transformation of Italian political system into a particracy, the secretaries of the parties having become more powerful than the Parliament and the Government.

zh.s: 1963年4月28日，意大利举行大选，选出第四届共和国议会。这是宪法于1963年2月进行第二次改革、规定议员人数固定后举行的首场选举。这也是基督教民主党秘书长首次在选后拒绝出任总理，并至少在六个月内暂时保留党内更有影响力的领导职位。此事表明，意大利政治体制已转变为由党派主导的体制：党魁的权力逐渐超过议会和政府。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Austria on 28 April 1963.The result was a victory for incumbent President Adolf Schärf of the Social Democratic Party, who received 55.4% of the vote. Voter turnout was 95.6%.

zh.s: 1963年4月28日，奥地利举行总统选举。现任总统、社会民主党候选人阿道夫·谢尔夫获胜，得票率为55.4%。投票率为95.6%。

en.s: General elections were due to be held for the Legislative Council in Nyasaland on 28 April 1964, and would have been the first in the country under universal suffrage. However, there were no opposition candidates to either the Malawi Congress Party in the general roll seats (the Nyasaland Asian Convention had dissolved itself and declared its support for the MCP), or the Nyasaland Constitutional Party in the special roll seats, resulting in all 53 candidates winning without votes being cast.

zh.s: 尼亚萨兰原定于1964年4月28日举行立法局大选，这将是该国首次实行普选。但在普通选区，马拉维大会党没有对手（尼亚萨兰亚洲人大会已解散并宣布支持该党）；在特别选区，尼亚萨兰宪政党也没有对手。因此，全部53名候选人均在无人投票的情况下当选。

en.s: The Battle of Sinoia, also known as the Battle of Chinhoyi, was a small military engagement fought near Sinoia (modern-day Chinhoyi) between a small unit of Zimbabwe African National Liberation Army (ZANLA) guerrillas and the Rhodesian police force on 28 April 1966. The skirmish is generally considered the opening engagement of the Rhodesian Bush War (Second Chimurenga) A team of seven ZANLA cadres engaged with British South Africa Police forces near the northern town of Sinoia.

zh.s: 西诺亚战役又称钦霍伊战役，于1966年4月28日在西诺亚（今钦霍伊）附近爆发，是一场小规模交战，交战双方是津巴布韦非洲民族解放军的一支游击队和罗得西亚警察部队。这场冲突通常被视为罗得西亚丛林战争（第二次契穆伦加）的开端。7名津巴布韦非洲民族解放军成员在西诺亚北郊与英国南非警察部队交战。

en.s: The 1968 Baden-Württemberg state election was held on 28 April 1968 to elect the members of the 4th Landtag of Baden-Württemberg. The incumbent Christian Democratic Union (CDU) government under Minister-President Hans Filbinger was re-elected.

zh.s: 1968年4月28日，巴登-符腾堡州举行选举，选出第四届州议会成员。由州长汉斯·菲尔宾格领导的现任基督教民主联盟政府再次当选。

en.t: Charles de Gaulle resigns as President of France
en.s: Charles André Joseph Marie de Gaulle (22 November 1890 – 9 November 1970) was a French general and statesman who led the Free French Forces against Nazi Germany and its puppet state of Vichy France in World War II and chaired the Provisional Government of the French Republic from 1944 to 1946 to restore democracy back in France.

zh.t: 夏尔·戴高乐辞去法国总统职务
zh.s: 夏尔·安德烈·约瑟夫·玛丽·戴高乐（1890年11月22日—1970年11月9日）是法国将军和政治家。第二次世界大战期间，他领导自由法国军队对抗纳粹德国及其傀儡政权维希法国，并于1944年至1946年主持法兰西共和国临时政府，推动法国恢复民主。

en.s: The 1973 FA Trophy Final was a football match between Scarborough and Wigan Athletic on 28 April 1973 at the Wembley Stadium, London. It was the final match of the 1972–73 FA Trophy, the fourth season of the FA Trophy, The Football Association's cup competition for non-league clubs in the English football league system.

zh.s: 1973年英格兰足总奖杯决赛于1973年4月28日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由斯卡伯勒对阵维冈竞技。这是1972至1973赛季足总奖杯的决赛，也是该项赛事的第四个赛季。足总奖杯是英格兰足球联赛体系中面向非联赛俱乐部的杯赛。

en.s: The 1974 WFA Cup Final was the fourth final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. It was the fourth final to be held under the direct control of Women's Football Association (WFA). Southampton and Fodens contested the match at the Eyrie, the former home of Bedford Town on 28 April 1974. Fodens won the match 2–1.

zh.s: 1974年英格兰女子足总杯决赛是该项赛事的第四场决赛。英格兰女子足总杯是英格兰女子足球队参加的主要杯赛，这也是该赛事由女子足球协会直接管理后举行的第四场决赛。南安普顿队与福登斯队于1974年4月28日在贝德福德镇队旧主场埃里球场交锋，福登斯以2比1获胜。

en.t: Bombing of Tan Son Nhut Air Base
en.s: The Bombing of Tan Son Nhut Air Base occurred on 28 April 1975, just two days before the Fall of Saigon. The bombing operation was carried out by the Vietnam People's Air Force (VPAF) Quyet Thang Squadron, using captured Republic of Vietnam Air Force (RVNAF) A-37 Dragonfly aircraft flown by VPAF pilots and RVNAF defectors led by Nguyen Thanh Trung who had bombed the Presidential Palace in Saigon on 8 April 1975.

zh.t: 新山一空军基地轰炸事件
zh.s: 新山一空军基地轰炸事件发生于1975年4月28日，距离西贡陷落仅两天。越南人民空军“决胜”中队使用缴获的越南共和国空军A-37“蜻蜓”攻击机发动轰炸，由越南人民空军飞行员及越南共和国空军投诚人员驾驶，阮成忠负责指挥。阮成忠此前曾于1975年4月8日驾驶飞机轰炸西贡总统府。

en.t: General Cao Văn Viên, chief of the South Vietnamese military, departs for the US as the North Vietnamese Army closes in on victory
en.s: Cao Văn Viên (Vietnamese pronunciation: [kaːw˧˧ van˧˧ viən˧˧]; December 21, 1921 – January 22, 2008) was a four-star army general in the Army of the Republic of Vietnam during the Vietnam War. He rose to the position of Chairman of the South Vietnamese Joint General Staff. Considered one of "the most gifted" of South Vietnam's military leaders, he was previously called an "absolute key figure" and one of "the most important Vietnamese military leaders" in the U.S.-led fighting during the Vietnam War.

zh.t: 南越军方首脑高文 viên 将军在北越军逼近胜利之际离开前往美国
zh.s: 高文 viên（越南语发音：[kaːw˧˧ van˧˧ viən˧˧]，1921年12月21日—2008年1月22日）是越南战争期间越南共和国陆军的四星上将，后来升任南越联合总参谋长。他被视为南越“最有才干”的军事领导人之一，曾被称为美国主导的越战中“绝对关键人物”以及“最重要的越南军事领导人”之一。

en.t: The Red Army Faction trial ends, with Andreas Baader, Gudrun Ensslin and Jan-Carl Raspe found guilty of four counts of murder and more than 30 counts of attempted murder
en.s: The Red Army Faction (German: Rote Armee Fraktion, pronounced [ˌʁoːtə ʔaʁˈmeː fʁakˌtsi̯oːn] ; RAF [ˌɛʁʔaːˈʔɛf] ), also known as the Baader–Meinhof Group or Baader–Meinhof Gang (German: Baader-Meinhof-Gruppe / Baader-Meinhof-Bande [ˈbaːdɐ ˈmaɪnhɔf ˈɡʁʊpə] ), was a West German far-left militant group founded in 1970, active until 1998, and formally designated a terrorist organisation by the West German government. The RAF described itself as a communist and anti-imperialist urban guerrilla group.

zh.t: 红军派审判结束，安德烈亚斯·巴德尔、古德伦·恩斯林和扬-卡尔·拉斯佩被判犯有四项谋杀罪及30多项谋杀未遂罪
zh.s: 红军派（德语：Rote Armee Fraktion，简称RAF），也称巴德尔—迈因霍夫集团或巴德尔—迈因霍夫帮，是西德一个极左翼武装组织，成立于1970年，活动至1998年，并被西德政府正式列为恐怖组织。红军派自称是共产主义和反帝国主义的城市游击队。

en.s: The Saur Revolution, also known as the April Revolution or the April Coup, was a violent coup d'état and uprising staged on 27 and 28 April 1978 by the People's Democratic Party of Afghanistan (PDPA), which overthrew Afghan president Mohammad Daoud Khan, who had himself taken power in the 1973 Afghan coup d'état and established an autocratic one-party system in the country. Daoud and most of his family were executed at the Arg presidential palace in the capital city of Kabul by Khalqist (a PDPA faction) military officers, after which his supporters were also purged and killed.

zh.s: 四月革命又称四月政变，是阿富汗人民民主党于1978年4月27日至28日发动的一场暴力政变和起义，推翻了阿富汗总统穆罕默德·达乌德汗。达乌德汗曾于1973年政变夺权，并在国内建立专制的一党制。人民民主党派系“人民派”的军官在首都喀布尔的阿格宫处决了达乌德及其大部分家人，之后他的支持者也遭到清洗和杀害。

en.t: The West German news magazine Stern published excerpts from the purported diaries of Adolf Hitler, later revealed to be forgeries
en.s: The Hitler Diaries (Hitler-Tagebücher) were a series of sixty volumes of journals purportedly written by Adolf Hitler, but forged by Konrad Kujau between 1981 and 1983. The diaries were purchased in 1983 for 9.3 million Deutsche Marks (£2.3 million or $3.7 million) by the West German news magazine Stern, which sold serialisation rights to several news organisations.

zh.t: 西德《明星》杂志刊登所谓《希特勒日记》的节选，后来证实日记系伪造
zh.s: 《希特勒日记》（Hitler-Tagebücher）共60卷，声称由阿道夫·希特勒撰写，实际是康拉德·库贾乌在1981至1983年间伪造的。1983年，西德新闻杂志《明星》以930万西德马克（230万英镑或370万美元）购入这些日记，并将连载权出售给多家新闻机构。

en.t: High levels of radiation resulting from the Chernobyl disaster are detected at Forsmark Nuclear Power Plant in Sweden, leading Soviet authorities to publicly announce the accident
en.s: On 26 April 1986, reactor 4 of the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant, located near Pripyat, Ukraine, exploded. With dozens of direct casualties and thousands of health complications stemming from the disaster, it is one of only two nuclear accidents rated at the maximum severity on the International Nuclear Event Scale, the other being the 2011 Fukushima nuclear accident, which happened in Japan.

zh.t: 瑞典福斯马克核电站测出切尔诺贝利事故造成的高辐射，促使苏联当局公开宣布事故
zh.s: 1986年4月26日，位于乌克兰普里皮亚季附近的切尔诺贝利核电站4号反应堆发生爆炸。事故造成数十人直接伤亡，并引发数千人的健康问题。国际核事件分级表中，只有两起核事故被评为最高等级；另一起是2011年发生在日本的福岛核事故。

en.s: Aloha Airlines Flight 243 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight flown by Aloha Airlines between Hilo and Honolulu in Hawaii. On April 28, 1988, the Boeing 737-200 airplane serving the flight suffered extensive damage after an explosive decompression in flight, caused by part of the fuselage breaking due to poor maintenance and metal fatigue. The plane was able to land safely at Kahului Airport on Maui.

zh.s: 阿罗哈航空243号班机是阿罗哈航空的一班夏威夷州内定期客运航班，往返希洛和檀香山。1988年4月28日，执行该航班的波音737-200客机因维护不善和金属疲劳导致部分机身断裂，飞行中发生爆炸性失压并严重受损。飞机最终安全降落在毛伊岛卡胡卢伊机场。

en.s: The 1990 WFA Cup Final was the 20th final of the WFA Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was played under the auspices of the Women's Football Association (WFA). Doncaster Belles and Friends of Fulham contested the match at the Baseball Ground, the former home stadium of Derby County F.C. on 28 April 1990. Doncaster Belles ended up winning the game 1–0.

zh.s: 1990年英格兰女子足总杯决赛是该项赛事的第20场决赛，也是英格兰主要的女子足球杯赛。比赛由女子足球协会主办，于1990年4月28日在德比郡足球俱乐部旧主场、棒球场球场举行，由唐卡斯特女队对阵富勒姆之友队。唐卡斯特女队最终以1比0获胜。

en.s: Space Shuttle Discovery (Orbiter Vehicle Designation: OV-103) is a retired American Space Shuttle orbiter. The spaceplane was one of the orbiters from NASA's Space Shuttle program and the third of five fully operational orbiters to be built. Its first mission, STS-41-D, flew from August 30 to September 5, 1984. Over 27 years of service it launched and landed 39 times, aggregating more spaceflights than any other spacecraft as of December 2024.
en.n: Space Shuttle Discovery launches on STS-39, the first unclassified shuttle mission for the United States Department of Defense.

zh.s: 发现号航天飞机（轨道器编号OV-103）是一架退役的美国航天飞机。它是美国国家航空航天局航天飞机计划中的一架轨道器，也是五架投入全面运行的轨道器中第三架建成的。它的首次任务是1984年8月30日至9月5日进行的STS-41-D任务。在27年服役期间，它发射并着陆39次。截至2024年12月，它的航天飞行次数超过任何其他航天器。
zh.n: 发现号航天飞机执行STS-39任务升空。这是美国国防部首个非机密航天飞机任务。

en.s: The 1992–1996 Afghan Civil War, also known as the Second Afghan Civil War, took place between 28 April 1992 — the date a new interim Afghan government was supposed to replace the Republic of Afghanistan of President Mohammad Najibullah—and the Taliban's occupation of Kabul establishing the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan on 27 September 1996.

zh.s: 1992至1996年阿富汗内战又称第二次阿富汗内战，始于1992年4月28日。当时原定由新的临时政府接替总统穆罕默德·纳吉布拉领导的阿富汗共和国。1996年9月27日，塔利班占领喀布尔并建立阿富汗伊斯兰酋长国，内战至此结束。

en.s: The Battle of Kabul was a series of intermittent battles and sieges over the city of Kabul during the period of 1992–1996. Throughout the Soviet–Afghan War from 1979 to 1989, and subsequent civil war (1989–1992) the city of Kabul saw little fighting. The collapse of Mohammad Najibullah's regime in April 1992 led to a peace treaty between the Afghan political parties and the establishment of the Islamic State of Afghanistan.

zh.s: 1992至1996年的喀布尔战役，是一系列断断续续发生在喀布尔城内的战斗和围城行动。1979至1989年的苏阿战争以及随后1989至1992年的内战期间，喀布尔几乎没有发生战斗。穆罕默德·纳吉布拉政权于1992年4月垮台后，阿富汗各政治派别达成和平协议，并建立阿富汗伊斯兰国。

en.s: The Taiwan McDonald's bombings (Chinese: 麥當勞爆炸案; pinyin: màidāngláo bàozhà àn; lit. 'McDonald's bombing incidents') occurred on April 28 and 29, 1992. Bombs were planted in or near various McDonald's restaurant franchises in Taiwan. The bombings – part of an extortion attempt – caused the death of a policeman and injuries to four civilians including two young children, and resulted in the temporary closure of certain McDonald's locations in Taiwan.

en.t: In Your House 7: Good Friends, Better Enemies
en.s: In Your House 7: Good Friends, Better Enemies was the seventh In Your House professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF) that took place on April 28, 1996 at the Omaha Civic Auditorium in Omaha, Nebraska. The event consisted of nine professional wrestling matches, five of which were broadcast live on pay-per-view. The main event of the show saw Shawn Michaels defeat Diesel in a No Holds Barred match to retain the WWF Championship. Other matches on the card included The Bodydonnas retaining the WWF Tag Team Championship by defeating The Godwinns and The Ultimate Warrior defeating WWF Intercontinental Champion Goldust by countout.

zh.s: 《In Your House 7：好友与宿敌》是世界摔角联盟（WWF）举办的第七场“In Your House”按次付费赛事，于1996年4月28日在内布拉斯加州奥马哈的市政礼堂举行。赛事共安排九场比赛，其中五场通过付费电视直播。主赛中，肖恩·迈克尔斯在一场无规则赛中击败柴油（Diesel），保住WWF冠军头衔。其他比赛包括Bodydonnas击败Godwinns，保住WWF双打冠军；终极战士则因淘汰计数获胜，击败了WWF洲际冠军Goldust。

en.s: The Port Arthur massacre was a mass shooting that occurred on 28 April 1996 at Port Arthur, a tourist town in the Australian state of Tasmania. The perpetrator, Martin Bryant, murdered 35 people and wounded 23 others, in the deadliest mass shooting by a lone gunman in modern Australian history. The attack led to fundamental changes in Australia's gun laws.

zh.s: 亚瑟港大屠杀是一起大规模枪击事件，于1996年4月28日在澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚州旅游小镇亚瑟港发生。凶手马丁·布莱恩特杀害35人、打伤23人。这是现代澳大利亚史上单人枪手造成死亡人数最多的枪击事件。袭击促使澳大利亚对枪支法律作出重大调整。

en.s: The 1996 Cupa României final was the 58th final of Romania's most prestigious cup competition. The final was played at the Stadionul Naţional in Bucharest on 28 April 1996 and was contested between Divizia A sides Steaua București and Gloria Bistriţa. The cup was won by Steaua.

zh.s: 1996年罗马尼亚杯决赛是该国最重要的杯赛第58届决赛。比赛于1996年4月28日在布加勒斯特国家体育场举行，由甲级联赛球队布加勒斯特星队对阵比斯特里察荣耀队。最终布加勒斯特星队夺冠。

It was the fifth final to be held under the direct control of the Football Association (FA). The match was contested by Liverpool and Croydon Women at The Den, home of Millwall. Future England goalkeeper Rachel Brown played in her first final at 15 years old.

zh.s: 1996年英格兰女子足总杯决赛是该项赛事的第27场决赛。这是英格兰女子足球主要杯赛由英格兰足球总会直接管理后举行的第五场决赛。利物浦女队与克罗伊登女队在米尔沃尔主场丹球场交锋。未来的英格兰国家队门将雷切尔·布朗15岁时首次参加足总杯决赛。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Mali on 28 April 2002, with a run-off on 12 May. Amadou Toumani Touré won the election with 65% of the vote in the second round.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Macedonia on 14 April 2004, with a second round on 28 April. They followed the death in an air crash in February of incumbent President Boris Trajkovski. Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski of the Social Democratic Union won the first round. As he failed to cross the 50% threshold, a second round was held in which he defeated Saško Kedev of Internal Macedonian Revolutionary Organization – Democratic Party for Macedonian National Unity.

en.s: The 2013 Dehradun Municipal Corporation election was a municipal election to the Dehradun Municipal Corporation, which governs Dehradun, the largest city in Uttarakhand. It took place on 28 April 2013. Vinod Chamoli of BJP became the mayor. He defeated the Congress candidate Suryakant Shasmana. In 2018, he was criticised for retaining the mayor post after he was elected as an MLA.

en.s: The 2013 Uttarakhand Municipal general elections were held in the Indian state of Uttarakhand on 28 April 2013. The Uttarakhand State Election Commission announced the poll dates on 5 April 2013. The results were declared on 30 April 2013. Elections are not held in the nagar panchayats of Badrinath, Kedarnath and Gangotri due to their status of temporary settlements.

en.s: The 2013 Tyrolean state election was held on 28 April 2013 to elect the members of the Landtag of Tyrol. The election was contested by a large number of parties and saw a significant shift in support between them. The governing Austrian People's Party (ÖVP) Social Democratic Party of Austria (SPÖ), while suffering relatively small losses, each suffered their worst results in history.

en.s: The Hama offensive (March–April 2017) was a military offensive launched by Syrian rebel groups led by Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) north of the city of Hama, as part of the Syrian Civil War. The offensive began on 21 March 2017, and the rebels aimed to recapture areas recaptured by the Syrian Armed Forces in the 2016 Hama offensive, as well as pushing into Hama city.

en.s: La Copa Junior Nuevos Valores (2017) (Spanish for "The New Values Junior Cup") was a professional wrestling tournament produced and scripted by the Mexican wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLLl; Spanish "World Wrestling Council"). CMLL's recurring La Copa Junior tournament featured second, third or fourth generation wrestlers completing against each other.

en.s: A general election was held in Spain on 28 April 2019 to elect the members of the 13th Cortes Generales under the Spanish Constitution of 1978. All 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies were up for election, as well as 208 of 266 seats in the Senate. It was held concurrently with a regional election in the Valencian Community.

en.s: The 2019 Rebellion was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Impact Wrestling. The event took place on April 28, 2019, at The Rebel Complex in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. It was the first event in the Rebellion chronology. Eight matches were contested at the event. In the main event, The Latin American Xchange (Santana and Ortiz) defeated The Lucha Bros (Fénix and Pentagón Jr.) in a Full Metal Mayhem match to win the Impact World Tag Team Championship.

zh.s: 2019年《Rebellion》是Impact摔角举办的一场按次付费赛事，于2019年4月28日在加拿大安大略省多伦多的The Rebel Complex举行，也是该系列的首场赛事。全场共进行了八场比赛。主赛中，拉丁美洲交易所组合（Santana和Ortiz）在一场“全面混战”赛中击败Lucha兄弟（Fénix和Pentagón Jr.），赢得Impact世界双打冠军。

en.s: A regional election was held in the Valencian Community on 28 April 2019 to elect the 10th Corts of the autonomous community. All 99 seats in the Corts were up for election. It was held concurrently with the April 2019 Spanish general election. This was the first early regional election ever held in the Valencian Community, as well as the first Valencian election to not be held concurrently with any other regional election.

zh.s: 2019年4月28日，瓦伦西亚自治区举行选举，选出该自治区第十届议会。议会99个席位全部改选。选举与2019年4月西班牙大选同日举行。这是瓦伦西亚自治区历史上首次提前举行的自治区选举，也是当地首次没有与其他自治区选举同时举行的选举。

en.s: Regional elections were held in Spain during 2019 to elect the regional parliaments of thirteen of the seventeen autonomous communities: Aragon, Asturias, the Balearic Islands, the Canary Islands, Cantabria, Castile and León, Castilla–La Mancha, Extremadura, La Rioja, Madrid, Murcia, Navarre and the Valencian Community. 814 of 1,208 seats in the regional parliaments were up for election.

en.s: The 2020 Ohio Democratic presidential primary took place through April 28, 2020, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2020 presidential election. In-person voting, originally scheduled for March 17, 2020 (along with three different states), had been cancelled due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The Ohio primary was a semi-open primary and awarded 154 delegates towards the 2020 Democratic National Convention, of which 136 were pledged delegates allocated based on the results of the primary.

zh.s: 2020年俄亥俄州民主党总统初选于4月28日结束，是2020年总统选举民主党初选的一部分。受新冠疫情影响，原定于3月17日举行的现场投票取消。此次初选为半开放式，分配了154名参加民主党全国代表大会的代表，其中136名是根据初选结果分配的承诺代表。

Aguililla is the hometown of CJNG leader Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes. The CJNG began their assault on Aguililla by making blockades on the highways. en.t: Terrebonne in the 2025 Canadian federal election
en.s: As part of the 2025 Canadian federal election on April 28, 2025, an election took place for the federal electoral district of Terrebonne in Quebec. The election was primarily between the incumbent MP, Nathalie Sinclair-Desgagné of the Bloc Québécois, and Tatiana Auguste, the candidate for the Liberal Party. Those two candidates together received more than three-quarters of the votes cast in the election.

zh.s: 作为2025年加拿大联邦大选的一部分，特雷博讷选区于2025年4月28日举行选举。主要竞争者是魁人政团现任议员娜塔莉·辛克莱-德加涅和自由党候选人塔蒂亚娜·奥古斯特。两人合计获得了超过四分之三的选票。

en.t: Burnaby Central in the 2025 Canadian federal election
en.s: An election occurred in the federal electoral district of Burnaby Central on April 28, 2025, as part of the 2025 Canadian federal election. Governor General Mary Simon dropped the writs of election on March 23, 2025, after Prime Minister Mark Carney advised her to dissolve Parliament. en.t: Carleton in the 2025 Canadian federal election
en.s: An election took place in the federal electoral district of Carleton on April 28, 2025 as part of the 2025 Canadian federal election. zh.s: 作为2025年加拿大联邦大选的一部分，卡尔顿联邦选区于2025年4月28日举行选举。自由党候选人布鲁斯·范乔伊以超过4300票的优势击败保守党党魁、反对党领袖皮埃尔·波利耶夫，爆冷胜出。竞选期间，这场选战被称为“全国最受关注的选战之一”。

en.s: Between 25 and 28 April 2025, Pakistani Armed Forces engaged a large group of militants attempting infiltration along the Pakistan-Afghanistan border near Hassan Khel, North Waziristan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. In two days of clashes, 54 militants were killed, followed by an operation that killed 17 more, raising the total to 71. Weapons, ammunition, and explosives were recovered. The incident marked one of the deadliest border clashes in recent years.

zh.s: 2025年4月25日至28日，巴基斯坦武装部队在开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省北瓦济里斯坦的哈桑凯尔附近、巴阿边境沿线，与一大批试图渗透的武装人员交战。两天的冲突中有54名武装人员被打死，随后的一次行动又打死17人，总数升至71人。现场缴获了武器、弹药和爆炸物。这是近年来伤亡最惨重的边境冲突之一。
